lines.text: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are learning about sleepy animals!
Who rests the most? Let's find out!
Three animal friends will show us. Count them with me. One, two, three!
Stretch and yawn. Let's go!
Who sits and sleeps in a tree, for most of the day?
Is it the koala? Or is it the pig?
It is the koala!
Here is the fun fact. A koala sits or sleeps for about twenty hours a day!
Twenty hours! That is almost the whole day. Shh.
Why does a koala rest so much? Hmm.
Its food is eucalyptus leaves, and they do not give it much energy. So it rests a lot!
Look at that sleepy koala.
Eucalyptus branches grow out at sharp angles. A koala tucks itself in, nice and snug.
Snug and safe, high in the tree. Sweet dreams, little koala!
Koalas often do their eating at night.
It may eat in one tree at night, and rest in a different tree in the day!
Say it with me. A koala rests about twenty hours a day!
Can you hug a tree like a koala? Hold on tight, and close your eyes.
Now yawn a big, sleepy koala yawn. Yawn! Shh.
Quick check! What does a koala do most of the day? Sleeping? Or running?
Sleeping! Shh. Great job!
Which big cat may rest for up to twenty hours a day?
Is it the lion? Or is it the cow?
It is the lion!
Here is the fun fact. A lion may rest for up to twenty hours a day!
Lying in the shade, taking a long, long nap. Yawn! Shh, let it sleep.
When is a lion the busiest? Hmm.
Early and late in the day, and at night! That way it stays out of the heat of the day.
Look at that big, sleepy lion.
Lions do their hunting at night, when it is cooler.
In the early morning and in the evening, lions are busy and awake. Up and about!
Lion friends lick each other, to groom. Lick, lick!
Grooming helps the lions in a family stay close friends. So sweet! Lick, lick, lick!
Say it with me. A lion rests most of the day!
Can you stretch like a lion after a nap? Big stretch, and a big yawn!
Now lick your paw, like a lion grooming. Lick, lick! Nice and clean!
Quick check! When is a lion busy? At night? Or at lunch time?
At night! And early and late in the day. You remembered!
Whose heart beats very, very slowly when it sleeps?
Is it the polar bear? Or is it the pig?
It is the polar bear!
Here is the fun fact. When a polar bear sleeps, its heart slows way down!
Put your hand on your heart. Can you feel it go thump, thump?
How slow can a sleeping polar bear's heart go? Hmm.
As slow as eight to ten beats in a whole minute! Thump. Thump. Thump.
Look at that big, white bear.
In summer and fall, some polar bears on land dig a sleeping pit.
Dig, dig, dig, then curl up inside. A cozy bed in the ground!
A polar bear sleeps, and its heart goes slow and steady.
Slow and steady, while it dreams. Shh! Sleep tight, polar bear.
Say it with me. A sleeping polar bear has a slow heart!
Can you dig a sleeping pit like a polar bear? Dig, dig, dig!
Now curl up, and breathe slow and steady. In, and out.
Quick check! When a polar bear sleeps, does its heart go slower? Or faster?
Slower! Thump. Thump. Super thinking!
Wow! We met three sleepy friends. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
Who sits or sleeps about twenty hours a day, in a tree?
The koala! Yes!
Who hunts at night and naps in the day?
The lion! That's right!
Whose heart goes slow when it sleeps?
The polar bear! You remembered!
You learned so many new things today.
Snug like a koala. Stretch like a lion. And slow and steady like a polar bear!
How do you like to rest?
Thank you for learning with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
